key_dates.details: Polls open 6:30 a.m. to 7:30 p.m. statewide. Photo ID required.
key_dates.label: Election Day

key_dates.details: At the Ashtabula County Board of Elections, 8 W Walnut St, Jefferson, OH 44047. Weekdays Oct 6-9, 12-16, 19-23: 8 a.m.-5 p.m.; Sat Oct 24: 8 a.m.-4 p.m.; Oct 26: 7:30 a.m.-7:30 p.m.; Oct 27: 7:30 a.m.-8:30 p.m.; Oct 28-30: 7:30 a.m.-7:30 p.m.; Sat Oct 31: 8 a.m.-4 p.m.; Sun Nov 1: 1 p.m.-5 p.m. (only Sunday). Photo ID required.
key_dates.label: Early in-person voting

key_dates.details: Must be RECEIVED by the BOE by 8:30 p.m., not merely postmarked. Absentee voting by mail began October 6.
key_dates.label: Absentee ballot application deadline

key_dates.details: Must be received by the BOE by 7:30 p.m. on Election Day. Mail ballots early and use VoteOhio ballot tracking to confirm receipt. You may return your ballot in person, or an eligible family member may deliver it as permitted by Ohio law.
key_dates.label: Absentee ballot return deadline

key_dates.details: Voter registration and address updates were due by 9 p.m. on October 5. This deadline has passed.
key_dates.label: Voter registration deadline

name: November 3, 2026 General Election
notes: For non-UOCAVA absentee ballots, Ohio law requires the return envelope to reach the county Board of Elections by close of polls on Election Day. Track a mailed ballot at VoteOhio.gov/Track. UOCAVA ballots have a separate deadline.
